create_Gamma_distribution: create a Gamma distribution with concentration and rate parameters for probabilistic modeling
sample_from_Gamma: sample random values from a Gamma distribution using a JAX PRNG key
compute_Gamma_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a Gamma distribution
calculate_Gamma_entropy: calculate the Shannon entropy in nats for a Gamma distribution
compute_KL_divergence_Gamma: compute the batched KL divergence between two Gamma distributions
